title: Thapar University · complete detailed scene
description: Recorded 4 m wind, 8 m physical temperature and tracer, summer/winter clear-sky sunlight
limits: Author-provided AEQD local east/north coordinates at 30.35447 N, 76.36621 E. Most building heights and flat terrain are assumptions.
Wind and tracer use model time; temperature is a separate controlled restart with 35.4 C air and 40 C surfaces.
Sunlight uses 2025 summer/winter days and Asia/Kolkata local time; clear-sky model, not observed irradiance.
Surrogate wind and tracer are not calibrated against measured campus conditions.
